- [IARC.1.5] **Source layout.** libds's sources and their companion
  internal `.h` files live under `runtime/src/libds/`. The engine's own
  modules sit at its top, and a subsystem with files of its own takes a
  subdirectory: `rete/` the matching network, `dsc/` the artefact loader,
  `rfcs/` the fact-stream codec, `series/` the series backings, and the
  others beside them. Public headers are a separate tree (see [IARC.1.4]).
